<translate>
The '''Namekian Frog''' is the native amphibian of [[Special:MyLanguage/Namek|Planet Namek]]. There is also a rare '''Ginyu variant''', shown as ''Frog (Ginyu)'': a cosmetic nod to Captain Ginyu that behaves and drops exactly like a normal frog.
</translate>

<translate>
== Spawning ==

Both frogs spawn in the Ajissa Plains, Sacred Land and Namekian Rivers biomes.
</translate>
{| class="wikitable"
! <translate>Frog</translate> !! <translate>Spawn weight</translate> !! <translate>Group size</translate>
|-
| <translate>Namekian Frog</translate> || 2 || 1–3
|-
| <translate>Frog (Ginyu)</translate> || 5 || 1
|}

<translate>
== Behavior ==

Both frogs are harmless and hop away when hurt.
</translate>

<translate>
== Drops ==

Both variants drop:
* 1–2 '''Raw Frog Legs''' (cooks if on fire, +0–1 Looting)

[[Special:MyLanguage/Namekian Trader|Namekian Traders]] also trade Raw Frog Legs.
</translate>
